response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack experience and notable geospatial project work via GISCollective, but lacks direct C++/Rust exposure in professional routing or navigation pipelines, and his core technical stack leans toward JavaScript/TypeScript and DLang, with only historical C++ use in academic contexts — insufficient to meet the role’s core requirement for modern systems-level development in routing data pipelines.
strengths: Proven geospatial experience via open-source GISCollective platform
Strong track record in distributed systems and low-latency applications
Demonstrated ability to learn and contribute across diverse tech stacks
concerns: No commercial C++ or Rust experience in routing, navigation, or geospatial data pipelines
Primary language focus is JavaScript/TypeScript, not the required systems languages
Limited evidence of fault-tolerant distributed systems design at scale for global routing
